import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+)\s*;?\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        name, expression = match.groups()
        values[name] = values[expression] if expression.isidentifier() else int(expression)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")) + ";")
